tool_schemas.name: google_search
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Serper-backed Google query for the authenticated client and returns the stored search job plus its SERP artifacts for the requested vertical; results are paged by `page` (1-based) and sized by `num` (provider-capped). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is disabled, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client has exhausted its quota. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `q` is empty, `num`/`page` are out of range, or `type`/`time_range` are not one of the allowed values.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate, enforce quotas, and attribute the search.

location.description: Free-form location hint for the search (city/region).

num.description: Number of results to return (provider-dependent cap).

page.description: Page number of results to fetch.

autocorrect.description: Whether the provider may autocorrect the query.

tool_schemas.name: scrape
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and extracts content from `url` via the provider and returns the stored scrape job plus extracted artifacts according to `extract` (and `render` when supported), optionally linking the scrape to an existing SERP item via `search_result_id`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is disabled, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client has exhausted its quota. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `url` is not a valid fully-qualified URL, `timeout_ms` is out of range, or `extract` is invalid, and NOT_FOUND when `search_result_id` is provided but does not match a stored SERP item for that client.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate, enforce quotas, and attribute the scrape.

url.description: Fully-qualified URL to fetch and extract content from.

search_result_id.description: Optional linked search result id to associate this scrape with a stored SERP item.

extract.description: What to extract from the fetched page.

render.description: Whether to request rendered content when supported by the provider.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to allow for the scrape request.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity derived from `api_key`, including the API key record (non-secret fields), allowed status, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is not in `active` status.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and look up the calling identity.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored search query jobs for the authenticated client, newest-first, with optional status/time filtering and cursor pagination. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is disabled.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and scope results to the caller.

created_from.description: Optional inclusive lower-bound filter on created_at (RFC 3339).

created_to.description: Optional inclusive upper-bound filter on created_at (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches one stored search query job by id for the authenticated client, including its persisted request parameters and summary fields. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist for the caller, UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is disabled.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and authorize access to the job.

search_query_id.description: Search query job id to fetch.

include_results.description: When true, also returns associated SERP items (paged).

results_limit.description: Maximum number of SERP items to include when `include_results` is true.

results_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for SERP items when `include_results` is true.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel a queued/running search query job for the authenticated client by transitioning its status to `cancelled` according to the lifecycle. Returns the updated job. Refuses with CONFLICT when the job is not in a cancellable state, NOT_FOUND when the job is not accessible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is disabled.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and authorize the transition.

search_query_id.description: Search query job id to cancel.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason recorded for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: list_scrape_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored scrape jobs for the authenticated client, newest-first, with optional status/time filtering and cursor pagination. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is disabled.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and scope results to the caller.

created_from.description: Optional inclusive lower-bound filter on created_at (RFC 3339).

created_to.description: Optional inclusive upper-bound filter on created_at (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_scrape_job
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel a queued/running scrape job for the authenticated client by transitioning its status to `cancelled` according to the lifecycle. Returns the updated job. Refuses with CONFLICT when the job is not in a cancellable state, NOT_FOUND when the job is not accessible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is disabled.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and authorize the transition.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason recorded for auditing.
